title: dose.sale_limits input
description: The sales to answer, in order (CR-D5: a bulk sell's copies in one call): each sale's lines, one per record and dose, with the units it sells.

record.description: The state's package record the units come from; only weightPerUnit (g) and analyteWeight (mg/g of raw psilocybin) are read. Any JSON value has an answer: a figure that isn't a usable number refuses the sale (DOSE-3, DOSE-4, DOSE-19), one that is null, absent or 0 too (DOSE-5).

qty.description: The units sold. Any JSON value has an answer: anything but an integer from 0 to a million refuses the sale (DOSE-3).
